subject.title: refactor: remove stale internal deprecated compatibility

question: Must this external compatibility-cleanup PR provide an exact-head live Gateway transcript, or should maintainers explicitly override the real-behavior proof gate because the change is internal-only?
rationale: The automated Testbox and contract evidence is strong, but repository policy treats it as supplemental rather than proof from a real setup.

options.title: Require live Gateway proof

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Explicitly accept the exact-head Testbox, contract, and focused regression evidence without a live runtime transcript.

recommendation.title: Require live Gateway proof
